impl K1: textures and materials (resume).summary:
Slice K1 (DESIGN 2: textures and the Map's materials) is finished and checked; nothing is blocked. A previous attempt had written all the files and stopped before reporting. This continuation re-checked what was on disk and ran every check again; no repo file needed to change.

**What's in the repo**
- **Nine textures** in src/gameplay/maps/map_01/textures/ (sand, salt_span, road, ford, sea, rock, ridge, scrap, garage). They are exact copies of the preflight's tested recipes, with readable ids and no uid lines.
- **15 of the 16 Map 01 materials** are re-written in place, keeping every file name and every reference:
  - Every textured material uses roughness 1.0 and the anisotropic mipmap filter (enum value 5, confirmed by running the engine).
  - World triplanar mapping, tile size in metres: sand and road 32, sea and channel 64 (the same sea texture, as DESIGN 2 asks), ford 32, rock and ridge 32, scrap/rust/container 16, Base walls 16 (scrap tinted to 0.55 grey), Garage floor 16 (garage texture).
  - The salt flat uses the non-tiling salt_span texture on its own UVs.
  - Tower legs are untextured dark steel and the depot ring is untextured pale paint.
  - fuel_tank.tres is untouched; its restyle belongs to slice K6.
- No scene, script, collider or layer was edited, so no MeshInstance3D count changed. The Map uses no inline materials.

**Cost**
- Draw calls of a windowed main-scene frame (both views together) are unchanged: 215 before and 215 after at the spawns, 146 and 98 at the map poses.
- Texture memory went from 42.3 to 57.0 MB.
- The first drawn frame takes 132 ms instead of about 33 ms, while the unit-choice panel is up. It is already fully textured (identical to frame 70, no magenta). From frame 3 on, frames take 5 to 10 ms.

**What I saw in the frames**
- Read against design/source/map01_colored.png, the Map looks like the drawing: tan sand, cream salt flat with cracks that read and never repeat across its 190 m, rust canyon walls around a tan road, a darker ridge, pale cyan fords, dark Base walls with rust Garage floors.
- Every ground colour is within 0.1 per channel of the drawing except the sea (0.20 off) and the channels (0.25 off). Both are navy on purpose so that Teal reads over them: dE 48 over the sea and 52 over the channels.
- I saw no visible texture repeat from the chase camera and no z-fighting. In two frames 5 cm apart, the count of strongly changed pixels went down slightly (5,895 to 5,709). The difference image shows only object edges and the texture shifting with the camera, no speckle.
- The surfaces sit well next to the rusty, weathered style of assets/art/vehicles/vehicle-design.png.

**Three decisions you may want to look at**
- **Ford made opaque.** The layout had it translucent. There is no ford bed to show through, and the drawing's fords are an even pale cyan.
- **Depot ring is pale paint, as DESIGN 2 binds, but the drawing has a dark dashed ring.** The pale ring reads only faintly on the cream salt flat. This is a finding for the orchestrator or art-director.
- **Teal over the ford is the weakest colour pair (dE 28).** That is the AC-13 legibility check, for slice K7's frames.
